variants.pinTitle: Soft Glam Wedding Guest Makeup
variants.pinDescription: Choose softly reflective rose on the lid, a diffused taupe crease, and a satin complexion so the look stays polished in daylight and evening photos. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Soft Glam Wedding Guest Makeup: how to fix the most common mistake

variants.pinTitle: Easy Date Night Makeup
variants.pinDescription: Use cocoa shadow close to the lashes, a rose cream on cheeks and lips, and pinpoint glow rather than a full layer of shimmer. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Easy Date Night Makeup: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: The liner looks harsh Likely cause: The pencil set before it was softened. Fix: Work one eye at a time and smudge immediately with a short dense brush.

variants.pinTitle: Polished Office Makeup in 10 Minutes
variants.pinDescription: Prioritize evenness around the eyes and nose, one matte taupe wash, curled lashes, and a muted cream color shared by cheeks and lips. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Polished Office Makeup in 10 Minutes: steps 1, 4 and 8

variants.pinTitle: Polished Office Makeup in 10 Minutes: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: The base looks patchy Likely cause: Concealer was blended after it dried. Fix: Apply and blend one small zone at a time with a damp sponge.

variants.pinTitle: Fresh Brunch Makeup
variants.pinDescription: Use sheer apricot on cheeks and lips, champagne only at the inner lid, and spot coverage so natural daylight still shows skin texture. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Fresh Brunch Makeup: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: The complexion looks greasy Likely cause: Dewy product was layered across the T-zone. Fix: Blot the center and keep glow on cheekbones and outer forehead.

variants.pinTitle: Holiday Party Shimmer Makeup
variants.pinDescription: Anchor antique-gold shimmer with a cream base, frame it with matte cranberry, and keep the lower edge clean for an evening look that remains wearable. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Holiday Party Shimmer Makeup: steps 1, 4 and 8

variants.pinTitle: Holiday Party Shimmer Makeup: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: Shimmer falls onto the cheeks Likely cause: A fluffy brush or dry lid was used. Fix: Pick up shimmer with a fingertip and press it over a tacky base before complexion.

variants.pinTitle: Easy Vacation Makeup
variants.pinDescription: Use a sheer bronze cream around the eye, coral on cheeks and lips, and spot coverage so the routine stays quick and easy to pack. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Easy Vacation Makeup: steps 1, 4 and 8

variants.pinTitle: Easy Vacation Makeup: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: Sunscreen pills under makeup Likely cause: The base was rubbed before sunscreen set. Fix: Wait several minutes, then press makeup on with fingers or a sponge.

variants.pinTitle: Elegant Dinner Party Makeup
variants.pinDescription: Build plum depth at the outer lash line, use pewter satin sparingly on the lid, and repeat muted wine on cheeks and lips for a unified result. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Elegant Dinner Party Makeup: steps 1, 4 and 8

variants.pinTitle: Elegant Dinner Party Makeup: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: Plum looks bruised Likely cause: It was blended too low without lash definition. Fix: Clean the lower edge and add espresso tightly between upper lashes.

variants.pinTitle: Natural Job Interview Makeup
variants.pinDescription: Even only the areas that need it, define lashes with soft brown, groom brows, and use a muted rose-beige lip that can be reapplied easily. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Natural Job Interview Makeup: steps 1, 4 and 8

variants.pinTitle: Natural Job Interview Makeup: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: The base looks mask-like Likely cause: Coverage was carried evenly over the entire face. Fix: Sheer the perimeter with a damp sponge until natural skin shows.

variants.pinTitle: Soft Glam for Hooded Eyes

variants.pinDescription: See the same face and makeup look progress at steps 1, 4 and 8, then follow the complete tutorial.

variants.pinTitle: Soft Glam for Hooded Eyes: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: The gradient disappears Likely cause: All shadow was placed inside the closed-eye crease. Fix: Re-map the transition while looking straight ahead.

variants.pinTitle: Everyday Makeup for Deep-Set Eyes
variants.pinDescription: Use a light satin across the mobile lid, keep medium shadow above rather than inside the socket, and concentrate liner between the lashes. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Everyday Makeup for Deep-Set Eyes: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: Eyes look more recessed Likely cause: Dark shadow was packed into the socket. Fix: Remove depth with a base-colored matte and brighten the lid.

variants.pinTitle: Elongated Eye Makeup for Round Eyes
variants.pinDescription: Pull mid-tone shadow outward from the outer iris, keep the inner lid bright, and place mascara toward the outer lashes to create length. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Elongated Eye Makeup for Round Eyes: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: The eye looks rounder Likely cause: Dark color circles the entire lash line. Fix: Remove inner lower shadow and focus definition from the outer iris outward.

variants.pinTitle: Soft Shimmer Makeup for Monolids
variants.pinDescription: Blend depth upward from the lash roots, press shimmer at the center of the visible lid, and keep the upper edge softly diffused. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Soft Shimmer Makeup for Monolids: steps 1, 4 and 8
variants.pinDescription: See the same face and makeup look progress at steps 1, 4 and 8, then follow the complete tutorial.

variants.pinTitle: Soft Shimmer Makeup for Monolids: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: Shimmer disappears Likely cause: It was placed only on the hidden lower lid. Fix: Look forward and press shimmer onto the visible center.

variants.pinTitle: Lifted Makeup for Downturned Eyes
variants.pinDescription: Stop shadow before the natural corner drops, lift the endpoint toward the brow tail, and keep the outer lower lash line mostly clean. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Lifted Makeup for Downturned Eyes: steps 1, 4 and 8
variants.pinDescription: See the same face and makeup look progress at steps 1, 4 and 8, then follow the complete tutorial.

variants.pinTitle: Lifted Makeup for Downturned Eyes: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: The wing follows the downturn Likely cause: The line was drawn along the last lashes to their lowest point. Fix: End earlier and place the endpoint with eyes open.

variants.pinTitle: Balanced Eye Makeup for Close-Set Eyes
variants.pinDescription: Keep the inner third bright and clean, begin deeper shadow after the pupil, and direct liner and mascara toward the outer half. Follow the same model through all eight cumulative steps.

variants.pinTitle: Balanced Eye Makeup for Close-Set Eyes: steps 1, 4 and 8
variants.pinDescription: See the same face and makeup look progress at steps 1, 4 and 8, then follow the complete tutorial.

variants.pinTitle: Balanced Eye Makeup for Close-Set Eyes: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: Eyes look closer together Likely cause: Dark shadow reaches the inner corner or nose bridge. Fix: Remove inner depth with a clean brush and add skin-tone satin.

variants.pinDescription: See the same face and makeup look progress at steps 1, 4 and 8, then follow the complete tutorial.

variants.pinTitle: Cool Rosy Makeup for Fair Skin: how to fix the most common mistake
variants.pinDescription: Rose looks like irritation Likely cause: Blush sits low and close to the nose. Fix: Lift placement toward the outer upper cheek and soften the inner edge.

variants.pinTitle: Warm Peach Makeup for Fair Skin: how to fix the most common mistake

variants.pinTitle: Rich Berry and Gold Makeup for Deep Skin

variants.pinTitle: Wearable Clean Makeup Look

variants.pinTitle: Natural Makeup for Mature Skin
